Congress alleges RSS leader met Pakistani officials, including ISI

Karnataka Congress chief B.K. Hariprasad has alleged that RSS leader Ram Madhav held four secret meetings with Pakistani officials, including an ISI officer. The Congress has raised questions about these meetings, targeting the RSS and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The allegations have led to political questioning regarding the nature and purpose of these interactions.
